hypothesis: On the four frozen finite domains with |X|=|Y|≤7, exact enumeration of H=Y^X recovers the overlapping-mixture mass, the cyclic identity-ρ class has size 7, and the m=8 LSM plug-in for the aligned truth is non-vacuous; wrong/random groups, π sign flips, and a hyperprior that only repeats weakness are independent kills of the extra readings.

controls.description: Domains, truths, group literals, OOD splits, π schedules, seeds, m, and δ are frozen in families.py / preregistration.json before class counts are inspected.
Each family carries aligned, incomplete, wrong, and random transformation families, plus a uniform 1/4 hyperprior over those four names.
IID certificates use uniform-on-X draws with labels f*. The prefix/coset split is a separate OOD lane and is not called IID.
uniform / high / low weights, renormalized onto nonempty levels, test whether qualitative KL order is an artifact of π.
The {shortcut, invariant} toy must reproduce masses 1/4 and 3/4.
No stochastic neural posterior is evaluated; that kill is withheld by construction.

gates.criterion: Each family enumerates exactly n^n functions.
Named-probe masses equal the overlapping-mixture formula on every frozen π schedule.
Cyclic identity-ρ equivariant class has size 7.
Every m=8 aligned-truth inverted bound is < 0.99.
Aligned truth-vs-shortcut KL sign is the same for uniform/high/low π.
Some IID seed has Spearman(W_aligned, KL_hyper) ≠ -1.
Wrong/random groups do not match the aligned-truth KL while the shortcut fails OOD.
Verdict is one of the four registered outcomes.
LSM is a plug-in; OOD is a separate lane; analytic-open P0 leftovers stay open.
